messages:
anya: Quick check — can we lock a 60m retro for the deploy incident last Thu? Prefer Wed or Thu next week. Agenda idea: timeline, root cause, detection/alerts, immediate mitigations, owners for follow-ups. Who needs to be there?
rahul: Wed works for me, prefer 11:00am PT. FYI oncall (sam) said mornings are tight, 11:00 PT is the sweet spot.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.example.com/event/retro-1791234567 — Wed 11:00am PT, 60m. Attendees: anya, rahul, maria, taylor, sam, olivia.
maria: 11:00 PT 👍 Please add infra lead (kevin) and PM (joanne) — they should help with rollout mitigation context. Also can we have a 5m follow-up slot to decide any changes to the deploy checklist?
taylor: I can facilitate & take notes if that helps. I'll draft a short timeline doc — can folks paste logs/alerts links here as they gather? Pre-read would be super helpful.
anya: Thanks taylor. Plan: taylor facilitate, rahul to do RCA draft, sam + olivia to collect logs/metrics. Maria: add the 5m deploy-checklist item. Sam/Olivia — can you upload artifacts by EOD Tue so I can circulate before the meeting?
sam: on it — will drop logs + oncall timeline to the folder: https://files.example.com/retro/1791234567 by 18:00 PT.
olivia: I'll run the latency queries and attach perf graphs. Also propose a short item to update the runbook with the new mitigation steps (assignable to eng-oncall).
rahul: I'll sketch the timeline + initial hypotheses tonight and link the doc. Will also call out gaps where alerts didn't fire.
taylor: Agenda draft (brief): 1) 10m timeline review 2) 15m root cause discussion 3) 15m detection & rollout gaps 4) 15m action assignment + owners 5) 5m checklist decision. Can we keep strict timeboxing? :hourglass:
ops-bot: Reminder set: please add any docs to the meeting thread.
anya: Perfect. Confirmed: Wed 11:00am PT, hybrid (zoom + in-office 3rd floor conf). Attendees confirmed: anya, rahul, maria, taylor, sam, olivia, kevin, joanne. If anyone else should be looped in, ping here. If you can't make it, add async comments in the doc before Wed morning.
rahul: +1, adding a small bullet for risk/rollback improvements.
maria: I'll bring the rollout timeline and decide on checklist changes.
sam: quick note — if 11:00 conflicts with paging window for oncall rotation, I can still attend but might need to step out briefly.
anya: noted — we'll record and circulate notes. Thanks everyone!
